channel.title: Notes — Syed Muhammad Ali
channel.description: Short technical notes on backend engineering, databases, performance and operations.

item.title: Defense in depth: securing the VPS and the application
item.description: How to think about VPS and application security as layers of defense in depth — network edge, firewall, host, runtime, application and data — and why no single layer is enough.

item.title: Zero-downtime schema changes: expand, then contract
item.description: Why renaming a database column in one migration takes production down, and the expand-contract pattern that ships schema changes with zero downtime.

item.title: Idempotency: the retry is not optional
item.description: Why retries are inevitable, how they cause duplicate charges, and how an idempotency key makes an operation safe to repeat.

item.title: The N+1 query: the loop that looks free
item.description: What the N+1 query problem is, why ORMs make it easy to write by accident, and how eager loading fixes it — with a Laravel example.

item.title: Caching: store, evict, and survive the stampede
item.description: A practical guide to caching for backend engineers: the latency ladder, cache-aside vs write-through vs write-behind, eviction, and cache stampedes.
